form.label: Change History
form.description: When the content of a page changed. Only checks that received a response have a content hash, so failed checks are left out.

search.query: sourcetype="web_ping" `website_monitoring_search_index` content_sha224=* | stats count by title | sort 0 title

sourcetype="web_ping" `website_monitoring_search_index` title=$title|s$ content_sha224=* | streamstats current=f last(_time) as changed last(content_sha224) as new_hash last(content_size) as size_after by source | where new_hash!=content_sha224 | rename content_sha224 as previous_hash, content_size as size_before | convert ctime(changed) | table changed title url size_before size_after previous_hash new_hash

sourcetype="web_ping" `website_monitoring_search_index` title=$title|s$ content_sha224=* | stats count as checks min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen latest(content_size) as content_size by source title url content_sha224 | sort 0 title -first_seen | `timesince(first_seen,since_first_seen)` | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | table title url first_seen since_first_seen last_seen checks content_size content_sha224
